title: Chief of Staff
description:
**About the role**
------------------


Zendr is entering an exciting next phase of growth and we’re now looking for a Chief of Staff to work closely with our CEO and leadership team. This is a highly strategic and hands-on role for someone who wants to operate at the center of the business, drive key initiatives forward and help shape how Zendr scales.


As Chief of Staff, you will act as a strategic thought partner to the CEO, helping translate vision and strategy into execution across the organization. You’ll ensure alignment between teams, remove internal friction and make sure our most important initiatives move forward efficiently and with clarity.


This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys solving complex problems and wants to have a real impact on both day-to-day execution and long-term direction.

### **Key responsibilities**

* Work closely with the CEO to shape, prioritize and execute Zendr’s strategic initiatives
* Act as a strategic thought partner and trusted advisor to the CEO and senior leadership
* Lead and manage cross-functional projects on behalf of the executive team, ensuring timely and effective execution
* Serve as a key liaison between the CEO, leadership team, board members and other stakeholders
* Ensure alignment across departments by improving communication, transparency and information flow
* Monitor and assess company performance, including key performance indicators and financial metrics
* Prepare executive-level materials such as board presentations, management reports and strategic updates
* Facilitate leadership meetings and strategic planning sessions, ensuring clear outcomes and follow-up
* Identify and proactively resolve internal challenges, acting as the CEO’s representative when needed
* Support the CEO by structuring priorities, coordinating key meetings and streamlining day-to-day operations

**About you**
-------------


You bring structure to complexity and are comfortable operating close to senior leadership. You’re analytical, proactive and trusted for your judgment. You enjoy both strategic thinking and hands-on execution, and you know how to influence across teams without formal authority.


You communicate clearly, build credibility quickly and are energized by helping organizations perform at their best.

### **We’re looking for someone who has**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, management, public policy, or related field
* 3–7 years of experience from roles such as management consulting, general management, executive support or senior operational roles
* Proven experience working closely with C-level executives as a strategic partner
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
* Fluency in Swedish and strong proficiency in English, both written and verbal
* Experience driving cross-functional initiatives and complex projects
* High organizational ability and comfort managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment
* Has a track record of using modern AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Notion AI) in daily work to automate routine tasks and improve personal productivity

### **High value if you also bring**

* Experience as a Chief of Staff or in a similar strategic advisory role
* Background from top-tier consulting firms (e.g. McKinsey, Bain, BCG)
* Experience from high-growth or scale-up environments
* Experience within operations, corporate strategy or project management
* Familiarity with board work, governance or executive communications

**About Zendr**
---------------


Zendr is a fast-growing, private equity-backed technology company headquartered in Stockholm. Founded in 2020 by co-founders Johan Sund and Mathias Rebane. Zendr has delivered years of rapid, profitable growth and has been named a DI Gasell three years in a row, Dagens Industri's recognition of Sweden's fastest-growing companies.  

  

Zendr offers a user-friendly, B2B transportation administration platform enabling customers to compare rates, book freight as well as manage and track shipments, targeting SMEs with complex shipping needs across all industries. The platform currently serves approximately 2,000+ businesses (sector agnostic), including prominent brands such as Halberg-Rassy, Swedish Agro, and BJÖRN BORG. The company has grown to operate in Sweden, Norway, and Denmark with an operational team of 60+ employees.


The platform is an all-in-one offering with flexible freight solutions through pre-negotiated freight rates with leading carriers, regardless of shipment type or destination, combined with in-house customer service supporting complex freight queries. This enables customers to compare rates, book, track, and manage all shipments within a single, automated system, designed to reduce operational complexity and costs. It features API integrations with key ERP and e-commerce systems to help teams access logistics data and automate shipping workflows, as well as an in-house developed proprietary cloud-platform, reducing the complexity of business logistics by simplifying and automating shipments, saving time and reducing costs for customers.


Following years of rapid, profitable growth, Zendr is entering its next phase of expansion through a new strategic partnership with a European Private Equity investor, providing significant capital and expertise to accelerate Zendr’s clear technology advantage and execute their next phase of growth.

### **Our hiring process**


We respect your time and aim to make the recruitment journey fast, transparent and enjoyable:

* **Application review** – We'll review your application promptly and get back to you within a few days.
* **First conversation** – An informal video call to learn more about you and share who we are.
* **Digital meeting with our CEO** - Meet our CEO and discuss the role further.
* **Case** - You'll be handed a case to perform to better understand your approach toa specific work task.
* **Case discussion** - We'll go through the case together and discuss what you've presented.


From first contact to final decision, you can expect clear communication, timely feedback, and respect for your time - because great talent deserves a great candidate experience.

**Additional information**
--------------------------


We review applications on a rolling basis, which means the position may be filled before the closing date. If you have any questions regarding the role or the recruitment process you're more then welcome to contact Ellen Plym via **ellen.plym@zendr.se**

**Start date:** As soon as possible

**Scope:** Full-time, permanent position

**Location:** Stockholm, Solna

* 5+ years of relevant experience in full-cycle, quota-carrying B2B sales, with a track record of closing net-new business preferred.
* Demonstrated success generating your own pipeline through disciplined prospecting.

### **BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:**

* Experience selling data, analytics, AI/ML, or cloud infrastructure solutions.
* Familiarity with the modern data stack and consumption-based pricing models.
* Hands-on use of AI tools to improve account research, outreach personalization, and meeting preparation.
* Experience with the Swedish or wider Nordic technology ecosystem.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Business Systems Expert
description:
**Challenge the Impossible**

**About Beyond Gravity**


Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1'900 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and produce solutions for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2025, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 402 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com.

  

**Our Crew**

  

The Operational Excellence team in Linköping plays a key role in ensuring that our business systems, processes, and data support efficient and scalable operations. Working closely with Supply Chain, Logistics, Production, Engineering, Finance, and IT, the team drives continuous improvement and enables the organization to get maximum value from its digital tools and business processes. This role has a strong focus on Logistics and Supply Chain processes, ensuring that our ERP landscape supports material planning, inventory management, procurement, manufacturing, and operational execution across the site. You will collaborate with both local stakeholders and global process owners to support business growth and operational excellence.

  

**Your Mission**

  

We are currently looking for an Business Systems Expert to champion the effective use of our Business Systems and drive continuous improvement across the organization. You will act as the bridge between business operations and system capabilities, helping users, improving processes, and ensuring the ERP environment supports efficient and data-driven decision-making. Your main tasks envolve:

  

* Act as the Business Expert for ERP-related processes, with a particular focus on logistics and supply chain operations.
* Drive standardization and continuous improvement of ERP workflows, master data structures, and business processes.
* Collaborate with process owners and stakeholders to identify improvement opportunities and implement best practices.
* Provide second-line support to key users and end users, coordinating with IT teams and software vendors when required.
* Maintain documentation, user guides, troubleshooting materials, and process descriptions to support knowledge sharing.
* Develop and deliver training programs for new and existing system users, ensuring effective system adoption.
* Coordinate and support the network of Super Users across departments and functions.
* Represent the business in ERP projects, system enhancements, upgrades, and new functionality rollouts.
* Support testing, validation, change management, and go-live activities related to system developments.
* Ensure compliance with master data standards, internal controls, governance requirements, and audit expectations.
  

**Your Story**

  

Must have's:

  

* 5+ years of experience with ERP systems in a Super User, Key User, or similar role.
* Experience with SAP and a strong understanding of ERP-supported business processes.
* Strong understanding of business processes within Supply Chain, Logistics and Manufacturing.
* Experience in training, change management and business process improvement.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  

Nice to have:

  

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.
* Experience from a manufacturing, aerospace, defense or other high-tech industry.
* Experience with Teamcenter and Opcenter.
* Knowledge of Lean working methods.
* Understanding of MRP, master data management and process mapping tools.

  

**Are you ready for lift-off?**

Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. Propel your career to new heights by applying before 31/12/2026. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.  



For questions regarding the position, please contact: Viktor Birkebro | viktor.birkebro@beyondgravity.com

title: BIM Engineers
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------


WiiGroup is seeking **Mid-Level and Senior BIM Engineers** to join our team in **Boden, Sweden**, supporting the delivery of a major industrial project.


The successful candidates will be responsible for coordinating, managing, and developing BIM models and information across electrical systems and multidisciplinary project teams. You will work closely with construction, engineering, design, and commissioning stakeholders to ensure BIM deliverables support project objectives, construction sequencing, quality requirements, and project milestones.


This opportunity is ideal for BIM professionals with strong **electrical and industrial project experience** who enjoy working within fast-paced construction environments and contributing directly to project success.

**Our Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------


You are a BIM Engineer with experience supporting large-scale industrial, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, energy, data centre, or mission-critical projects.


You possess strong technical BIM capabilities and understand how coordinated digital information supports construction delivery. You are comfortable engaging with site teams, electrical contractors, engineers, and project stakeholders to resolve coordination issues and improve project outcomes.


You are detail-oriented, proactive, and passionate about leveraging technology to improve construction processes and project performance.

**Experience Required**
-----------------------

* 3-8+ years of BIM experience within construction, engineering, industrial, or mission-critical projects.
* Strong experience working on **electrical systems** including power, lighting, containment, cable routing, and associated infrastructure.
* Industrial project experience is essential.
* Proficiency in Autodesk Revit and Navisworks.
* Experience carrying out clash detection, model reviews, and multidisciplinary coordination.
* Experience supporting BIM execution plans, modelling standards, and project BIM workflows.
* Familiarity with Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), BIM 360, or similar Common Data Environment platforms.
* Strong understanding of construction drawings, technical documentation, and project delivery processes.
* Experience coordinating with electrical contractors, consultants, and project delivery teams.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining high levels of accuracy.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
* Fluency in English is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Produce, develop, and maintain BIM models for electrical systems and associated infrastructure.
* Coordinate BIM activities across multidisciplinary project teams.
* Perform clash detection, model audits, and constructability reviews.
* Support the implementation of BIM standards, workflows, and project requirements.
* Participate in coordination meetings with designers, contractors, and client representatives.
* Ensure BIM deliverables are produced in line with project schedules and quality standards.
* Manage model federations and support digital project delivery initiatives.
* Review and validate design information prior to construction activities.
* Support field teams through model-based problem solving and coordination.
* Assist with model-based quantity take-offs, reporting, and project analysis where required.
* Maintain accurate project information within Autodesk Construction Cloud.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and BIM best practices.

**What's on Offer**
-------------------


Joining WiiGroup means becoming part of a collaborative and innovative team delivering some of Europe's most exciting construction projects. We are committed to investing in our people through professional development, technology, and a culture of continuous improvement.


Benefits include:

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.
* Accommodation and relocation support where applicable.
* Pension Scheme to secure your future.
* Private Health Insurance.
* Opportunity to work on a major industrial project in Sweden.
* Career progression into Senior BIM Engineer, BIM Coordinator, and BIM Management roles.
* Ongoing training and professional development support.
* Access to the latest digital construction technologies and BIM platforms.
* Wellness initiatives focused on physical and mental wellbeing.
* International project exposure and long-term career growth opportunities.

**Next Steps**
--------------


If you're ready to take the next step in your BIM career and join a company driving innovation within the construction industry, we encourage you to submit your application today.


Send your CV to **careers@wiigroup.com**.


Join our growing team in **Boden, Sweden** and help shape the future of digital construction delivery across Europe's largest industrial projects.


By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the collection, processing, and storage of your personal information by WiiGroup for recruitment purposes only. All information will be treated confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. If you wish to withdraw your application at any stage, please contact **careers@wiigroup.com**.

title: Account Executive, Enterprise (Sweden & Norway)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.



This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

**THE ROLE**
------------



As a Senior Account Executive, you'll open up a new enterprise territory for Everpure, focused on the energy sector and large public sector organisations. Based in Sweden, you'll cover a set of strategic accounts primarily in Sweden, alongside a number of accounts in Norway and Finland.



This is close to a blank-sheet territory. You'll lead the full sales cycle, from first conversation to close, and build strong relationships with customers and partners as you win new logos. As Everpure leans further into software and data management, it's a rare chance to shape a territory from the ground up and champion our solutions to complex business challenges.

* Lead the full sales cycle on complex enterprise opportunities, directing pursuit teams and executing strategic account plans to secure new customers.
* Drive revenue growth and consistently exceed your sales quota.
* Build trusted, long-term relationships with stakeholders at all levels, positioning Everpure as a strategic advisor and partner.
* Collaborate closely with channel partners to leverage their networks and expertise, extending our reach and maximising opportunities across the region.

------------------

* A genuine hunter mindset: you've won new logos and built pipeline from scratch, not only grown existing accounts.
* Expertise in prospecting, account planning and building relationships with senior stakeholders across an organisation.
* Experience working with channel partners and using those relationships to drive sales and market penetration.
* A background in software, data management or cloud. Experience from modern data platform companies is highly valued; a storage industry background is welcome but not required.
* Fluency in Swedish and English.


**Nice to have**


* Experience selling into the energy sector, particularly national electricity grid companies, or into large public sector organisations.

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:**


* **Innovation**: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

title: Oracle Integration Consultant

title: GRC Engineer
description:
**TL;DR** We’re looking for a GRC Engineer who can turn regulatory requirements and security/privacy requirements into scalable engineering solutions.

 **Why Lovable?**
  

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.


We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.


Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

 **What We're Looking For**

* An engineer who has built compliance controls from the ground up.
* Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or similar frameworks.
* Strong architectural understanding and hands-on experience of common cloud infrastructures.
* Ability to automate compliance controls using code, scripts, or infrastructure tooling.
* A collaborative mindset - comfortable working with engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders like legal and marketing alike.

 **What You'll Do**
  

In one sentence: Design compliance-by-design systems, automate controls and monitoring, and work cross-functionally to turn regulatory and business requirements into scalable technical solutions for secure data, privacy, and responsible AI.

* Design and implement compliance-by-design systems across our infrastructure that people actually want to use.
* Automate compliance controls and monitoring using modern tooling.
* Work closely with engineering teams to ensure systems meet SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and emerging AI regulations.
* Partner with sales, product, platform, and legal teams to translate requirements and needs into technical implementations.
* Help shape the architecture around data handling, privacy, and responsible AI.

 **Our tech stack**  

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

* **Frontend:** React
* **Backend:** Golang and Rust
* **Cloud:** Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers
* **DevOps & Tooling:** Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)


And always on the lookout for what's next!  

  

**About Your Application**
  

Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Senior teknisk konsult
description:
##### **Det här gör rollen som Senior teknisk konsult intressant**

* Forma Proacts erbjudande och arbetssätt inom virtualisering tillsammans med kollegor som redan arbetar inom området.
* Ta helhetsansvar för leveransen när du planerar, bygger och uppgraderar kunders privata moln med VMware Cloud Foundation.
* Kombinera teknisk fördjupning med rådgivning, och dela din kunskap med kollegor i teamet.

**Mitt namn är Sebastian Dozzi och jag är Consultant Manager.** Jag anpassar mitt ledarskap efter situationen och bygger det på tydliga förväntningar, stort eget ansvar och nära samarbete. I teamet kan du förvänta dig att jag lyssnar in ditt perspektiv, undanröjer hinder och hjälper dig att lyckas i dina uppdrag.

##### **Din roll som senior VCF-konsult**

**Ansvar:** Du får ansvar för att vara teknisk rådgivare i kunduppdrag inom VMware Cloud Foundation och för att leda leveranserna från start till mål. Som senior konsult arbetar du självständigt och tar ett helhetsansvar för den tekniska leveransen, från de första vägvalen till en färdig miljö. Du hjälper kunderna att planera, bygga och uppgradera sina miljöer så att de får en stabil och framtidssäker plattform. Erfarenheterna från uppdragen tar du med dig in i teamet, så att vi tillsammans kan möta fler kunders behov framåt.

**Samarbete:** Tillsammans med teamet ser du till att fler kunder får det stöd de behöver när de moderniserar sina miljöer. Du arbetar främst ute hos kunder, nära deras beslutsfattare, och samarbetar tätt med dina konsultkollegor inom virtualisering. Ungefär en gång i månaden ses konsulterna för workshops, kunskapsutbyte och ibland gemensamt arbete med kunder.

**Kärnaktiviteter:**

* Analysera kundens behov och förutsättningar och rekommendera vägval kring VMware och VCF.
* Led tekniska projekt där kunders miljöer designas, uppgraderas eller migreras till VCF, och bidra själv i implementationen när det behövs.
* Dela teknisk kunskap med kollegor

##### **Fördelar med att börja hos Proact**


Vi tror att en bra arbetsplats handlar om mer än förmåner. Det handlar också om kultur, utvecklingsmöjligheter, samarbete och att trivas i vardagen. Här är några av de saker du kan förvänta dig hos oss:

* Hög grad av ägandeskap och påverkan i ditt dagliga arbete med korta beslutsvägar.
* Kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling genom investeringar i utbildningar, certifieringar och vår gemensamma utveckling.
* Balans i livet som gör att vardagen fungerar.


Ett urval av våra förmåner:

* Generöst friskvårdsbidrag samt möjlighet till privat vårdförsäkring och förmånscykel.
* Tjänstepension och föräldralön vid föräldraledighet.

##### **Vem vi tror kan trivas i rollen**


Vi tror att du trivs med att ta initiativ, prioritera och hålla ihop arbetet i komplexa kunduppdrag. Du förklarar tekniska vägval så att beslutsfattare kan fatta beslut. Du tar också gärna ansvar för att leda och stötta andra, utan att det behöver vara en formell chefsroll.


Det är viktigt att du har:

* Praktisk erfarenhet av VMware vSphere i produktionsmiljö, till exempel av att designa, driva eller felsöka miljöer.
* Erfarenhet av VCF eller dess komponenter, som vSAN, NSX eller SDDC Manager, till exempel inom design, uppgradering eller migrering.
* Erfarenhet från en kundnära roll där du har presenterat lösningar eller vägval för beslutsfattare.
* Förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
* Möjlighet att genomgå säkerhetsprövning, eftersom rollen kräver det.


Vi har inga formella utbildningskrav. Det viktiga är vad du kan och har gjort.

**Meriterande**

* Erfarenhet av lagring, backup eller automation i kombination med VMware, till exempel NetApp, Rubrik, NetBackup, Ansible eller PowerCLI.
* En VMware-certifiering, till exempel VCP-VCF eller VCP-DCV.
* Erfarenhet av att leda projekt eller vara mentor.


Känner du igen dig i mycket, men inte allt?


Erfarenheter kan se olika ut. Om du har en stark grund inom VMware och virtualisering och tror att du kan bidra i rollen vill vi gärna höra från dig.

##### **Vad kan du förvänta dig härnäst?**


För att säkerställa en rättvis och kompetensbaserad rekryteringsprocess går vi igenom ansökningar löpande. Vi förväntar oss följande steg i rekryteringsprocessen:

* Inledande samtal med ansvarig rekryterare Titus
* Första intervju och lunch med rekryterande chef Sebastian
* Andra intervju med Robin och Christian
* Referenser och bakgrundskontroll

You will lead our Card Issuing Risk and Compliance team, combining people leadership with responsibility for regulatory compliance and privacy performance. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Operations and other key stakeholders, you will help translate complex regulatory requirements into practical guidance, controls and implementation plans.


This is an opportunity to shape how we approach risk and compliance, strengthen collaboration across the organization and ensure that regulatory requirements are embedded into our products, services and ways of working.

* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and standards such as GDPR, DORA, PSD3/PSR, the EU AI Act, PCI DSS or ISO standards.
* Understanding of operational resilience, information security, supplier risk or financial crime controls.
* Experience supporting regulatory reviews, customer assessments, audits, certifications or remediation programs.
* Experience working across multiple countries or markets within a regulated environment.
* Relevant education or professional qualifications in law, compliance, risk management, information security or financial services.

We offer you professional growth, meaningful projects, open culture and an outstanding work-life balance! title: Senior Solutions Engineer (Remote Europe)
description:
**The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.**


n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.


Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

* Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
* Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
* Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

  

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what *you* can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.


We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Solutions Engineer, you will be the primary technical partner for our Enterprise sales engagements. You’ll work closely with Account Executives to guide prospects through technical discovery, product evaluations, and proofs of concept — helping them validate that n8n can operate securely, reliably, and at scale in their environment.


This is a customer-facing, hands-on role focused on complex Enterprise use cases. You will spend your time working directly with technical stakeholders, leading technical conversations, and ensuring Enterprise customers clearly understand how n8n fits into their systems and processes.

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Lead Enterprise technical discovery, deep-dive calls, and tailored demos, showing how n8n fits into complex customer environments while addressing security, scalability, and reliability requirements
* Partner closely with Account Executives to assess technical fit, shape deal strategy, and handle technical objections, delivering demos grounded in real Enterprise workflows and use cases
* Own Enterprise POCs end-to-end, from scoping success criteria to hands-on technical guidance throughout the evaluation
* Help customers validate n8n in real-world conditions and capture POC learnings to improve qualification, conversion, and handoff to Solution Architecture/Customer Success
* Build strong relationships with IT, Security, Platform, and Engineering stakeholders, acting as the primary technical contact during Enterprise evaluations
* Clearly explain n8n’s approach to security, deployment, governance, and scale, helping customers plan adoption beyond their first use case
* Collaborate with Sales to improve Enterprise technical discovery, demos, and POC frameworks
* Provide structured feedback from Enterprise customers to Product and Engineering, and contribute to enablement materials that strengthen Enterprise sales motions

**Must-have**
=============

**Sales Engineering Experience:** You have 6+ years of experience in a technical pre-sales or Sales Engineering role, ideally within B2B SaaS, with direct exposure to enterprise customers

**Excellent Communication Skills:** You can clearly articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and confidently engage with enterprise stakeholders

**Commercial Acumen:** You understand sales processes and can creatively translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions

**Relationship Building:** You excel at building and maintaining relationships with clients, particularly within infrastructure teams on deployment requirements

**Strong Technical Proficiency: You bring hands-on experience with:**

* API integrations, OAuth, and authentication/authorization concepts
* JavaScript and/or Python for scripting, integrations, or demos
* Containerization and orchestration concepts (Docker, Kubernetes)
* CI/CD and DevOps practices, including integrating applications into CI/CD pipelines
* Networking fundamentals, security best practices, and observability concepts

**Cloud & Infrastructure Awareness:** You have a solid understanding of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and common cloud services used in modern SaaS architectures

**Startup Experience:** You thrive in fast-paced, high-ownership startup environments and enjoy wearing multiple hats

**Travel-Ready:** You’re open to occasional travel and onboarding sessions with the team in EMEA as needed

**Nice-to-have**
================

* **AI & Automation Experience:** Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with AI/LLM platforms, including concepts such as:


	+ LLMs, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agents, and orchestration frameworks
	+ Integrating AI capabilities into workflows or customer-facing solutions
	+ Exposure to ML infrastructure or AI-enabled automation platforms
* **Advanced Technical Background:** You hold a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a similar technical training
* **Community & Open Source Engagement:** You are active in technical communities or have experience contributing to or working with open-source projects
* **Product Familiarity:** Experience with n8n or similar workflow automation, integration, or iPaaS tools
* **Data-Driven Mindset:** You’re comfortable collecting, analyzing, and using data to improve pre-sales processes, POCs, and customer outcomes

*n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

*We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.*

***Our company language is English.***

*You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our* *Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n* *(**https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35**).*

***Location disclaimer:*** *If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.*

**Benefits**
------------

* **Competitive compensation** – We offer fair and attractive pay.
* **Ownership** – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.
* **Work/life balance** – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:


	+ **Europe:** 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.
	+ **US:** 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.
* **Health & wellness** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US**: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.
* **Future planning** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US:** 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.
* **Financial security** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US:** Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.
* **Career growth** – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.
* **A passionate team** – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!
* **Remote-first** – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.
* **Giving back** – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.
* **Transparency** – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

You will be a trusted partner to our customers, leveraging your experience with cloud transformations to help shepherd them through their stages of AWS adoption. You will drive customer value realization, building business cases and ensuring adoption leads to measurable outcomes such as efficiency gains, cost savings, or growth. You will evangelize AWS services and influence customers to adopt them. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by deploying AWS solutions and inspiring innovation. You will be obsessed with contributing to the day-to-day management of your customers’ successful adoption of AWS.  

  

Do you look around corners for ways to engage and service customers? Are you passionate about using technology to solve business problems that have big customer impact?  

  

Come build the future with us.  

  

A day in the life  

Your day might include participating in strategic planning sessions with customers, coordinating with internal AWS teams, reviewing adoption progress, and identifying opportunities for innovation. You'll balance relationship building with technical guidance while ensuring customer success.

* Experience using AI and automation tools to accelerate delivery and reduce manual effort

title: Advanced Repair Engineer
description:
MilDef verkar på en global marknad med världsledande taktiska IT-lösningar. Vi skräddarsyr produkter och system som är byggda för att prestera, även i de mest krävande miljöerna.


Nu söker vi en **Advanced Repair Engineer** till vårt team i Helsingborg.


**Din nya utmaning**  

Detta är i praktiken en roll som **Advanced** **Repair Engineer**, där huvudfokus ligger på avancerad felsökning och reparation av kretskort på komponentnivå, analys av återkommande fel, samarbete med utvecklingsavdelningen samt tekniskt stöd till externa tillverkare. Rollen kräver gedigen erfarenhet av elektronikdiagnostik och mätinstrument samt förmåga att driva kvalitetsförbättringar i produktionsmiljö.

* Förbättra MilDefs produkters tillförlitlighet och operativa beredskap genom att utföra avancerad felsökning och reparation av elektroniska enheter och system som inte klarar produktionskraven.
* Stärka produktionseffektiviteten och kvaliteten genom kvalificerad diagnostik på komponent- och kretskortsnivå, vilket minskar omarbete och förebygger återkommande fel.
* Säkerställa kvalitet och leveransprecision genom att externa tillverkningspartners får korrekt dokumentation, programmeringsfixturer och verktyg för noggrann tillverkning av kretskort.

**Den första intervjun i rekryteringsprocessen sker på plats och består av ett arbetsprov med fokus på felsökning på komponentnivå.**

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**

* Diagnostisera och reparera komplexa fel på kretskorts- och komponentnivå med hjälp av specialiserad test- och mätutrustning för att återställa produktens funktion.
* Fungera som eskaleringspunkt för produktionsrelaterade systemfel som kräver avancerad felsökning utöver ordinarie reparationsprocesser.
* Samarbeta med forskning och utveckling (R&D) samt team för introduktion av nya produkter (NPI) för att analysera fel och rekommendera konstruktionsförbättringar.
* Dokumentera korrigerande åtgärder baserat på rotorsaksanalyser och feltrenddata för att stödja kontinuerliga förbättringar.
* Upprätthålla strukturerade reparationsloggar och teknisk dokumentation för att säkerställa spårbarhet i reparationsarbetet.
* Leverera korrekt dokumentation, programmeringsfixturer och instruktioner till externa tillverkningspartners för produktionsändamål.
* Stödja utvecklingen av testriggar och programmeringsfixturer för både interna och externa tillverkningsverksamheter.

**Vi söker dig med**

* Minst 3 års praktisk erfarenhet av elektronikreparation, felsökning eller felanalys i produktions- eller serviceverksamhet.
* Kandidatexamen inom elektronik, mekatronik eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
* Dokumenterad förmåga att läsa och tolka elscheman/kretsscheman för kretskort samt använda olika elektroniska diagnosverktyg.
* Kompetens inom lödning (inklusive ytmonterad teknik, SMT), varmluftsomarbete och hantering av komponenter med små anslutningsavstånd.
* God vana att använda oscilloskop, logikanalysatorer, multimetrar och annan relevant mät- och testutrustning.
* Dokumenterad förmåga att diagnostisera och reparera fel på komponentnivå på komplexa kretskort.
* Dokumenterad förmåga att skapa tydlig teknisk dokumentation.
* God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.

**Meriterande om du har**

* Erfarenhet av **JTAG-gränssnitt (Joint Test Action Group)**, programmerbara testplattformar och avancerade funktioner i oscilloskop.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med robustiserad elektronik eller militärklassad utrustning.
* Kunskap om strukturerade problemlösningsmetoder såsom **8D (Eight Disciplines)** eller **DMAIC (Define–Measure–Analyze–Improve–Control)**.
* Erfarenhet av att stödja externa tillverkningspartners i en produktionsmiljö.
* Erfarenhet av utveckling av testriggar och samordning av testfixturer.
* **IPC-A-610** (Acceptanskriterier för elektroniska sammanbyggnader)
* **IPC-7711** (Omarbetning, modifiering och reparation av elektroniska sammanbyggnader)
* Relevanta **J-STD-standarder** för lödning (exempelvis J-STD-001).

**Lär känna oss**


På MilDef blir du en del av ett företag som värdesätter praktiskt engagemang, gemenskap och utveckling av ledande försvarsteknik. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla nya färdigheter, bidra i tvärfunktionella projekt och göra en konkret skillnad för vår fortsatta framgång. Vi uppmuntrar kontinuerligt lärande, samarbete, och erbjuder goda möjligheter till karriärutveckling. Vi är stolta över att aktivt främja hälsa och balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Det gör vi bland annat genom att erbjuda attraktiva förmåner samt hälsofrämjande initiativ, som wellness-aktiviteter på arbetstid.


Vill du veta mer om MilDef, våra produkter och vår kultur? Läs mer här MilDef.com


För mer information om rollen, vänligen kontakta TA- Specialist Sanna Ekelöf

**Viktig information**


Vi genomför drogtester på alla våra framtida kollegor innan anställning.


På grund av verksamhetens karaktär kan anställning, oavsett befattning, förutsätta bakgrunds- och säkerhetsrelaterade kontroller.

***MilDef - WE ARMOR IT.***

*MilDef is a global systems integrator and full-spectrum provider specializing in rugged IT for military, government and critical infrastructure sectors. MilDef provides hardware, software, and services that shield and protect critical information streams and systems, when and where the stakes are the highest. MilDef’s products are sold to more than 200 customers through companies in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, the United States and Australia, and through partner networks in more than 40 countries. MilDef was founded in 1997 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2021.*
